rationale: C14 is the immediately preceding annual proclamation on the identical observance and plausibly supplied material language and structure for the child. Both begin by declaring that qualified persons should not be denied employment because of physical handicap, discuss overcoming misunderstanding by employers and coworkers, cite the same 1945 joint resolution, and use nearly identical operative language calling upon the Nation to observe the designated October week. C01 and C04 are also strong predecessors in the same drafting lineage, but C14 is closest in time and language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas equal opportunity for employment is basic to our belief in human dignity and should never be denied any qualified person because of physical impairment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas opportunity for employment should not be denied any qualified person because of a physical handicap
shared_material.explanation: The child's opening premise closely recasts C14's distinctive opening proposition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the full use of this source of manpower depends upon better understanding on the part of employers, fellow employees and all our citizens across the land
shared_material.parent_excerpt: increased community efforts to overcome misconceptions among employers and co-workers concerning the handicapped
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same administrative-public-education rationale focused on employer and coworker understanding.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the Congress, by a joint resolution approved August 11, 1945 (59 Stat. 530), designated the first week in October of each year as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the observance of National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week each year, as authorized by the joint resolution of the Congress approved August 11, 1945 (59 Stat. 530)
shared_material.explanation: The same resolution is incorporated in corresponding final recitals.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 6, 1957, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do call upon the people of our Nation to observe the week beginning October 7, 1956, as National Employ the Physically Handicapped Week
shared_material.explanation: The core operative sentence is virtually identical apart from the annual date.
